svg.title: 10. Overhead side bend — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Stand with feet hip width apart. Raise one arm above your head. Bend your trunk gently away from the raised arm.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Standing_Lateral_Stretch.json
